content.comment_body: Hello, I was testing the feature to change the user of the [product_name] via SMS. When I use a phone number with the format "+60xxxxxxxxxx" (13 characters), I receive an SMS reply indicating: CHANGEUSER="xxxxxxxx","+60xxxxxxxxxx":No Success. However, if I use a number without the country code, such as "0xxxxxxxxxx" (11 characters), the reply is: CHANGEUSER="xxxxxxxx","0xxxxxxxxxx":OK. According to the manual, the maximum allowed characters should be 20. Despite this, numbers with 13 characters are producing an error. Can anyone suggest why this is happening? I've also attached the relevant manual page showing the character limit.
My suggestion is to create a support request for further assistance.
Hello, thank you for the advice. I've submitted a support request and will share any updates or solutions here when available.

analysis.insight_summary: The user identified a mismatch between the documented and actual limits for phone number length in the [product_name] communication module. While documentation allows up to 20 characters, attempts to use a 13-character number with a country code fail, whereas an 11-character local number succeeds. This inconsistency results in confusion and undermines confidence in the documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the module to process phone numbers of up to 20 characters as described in the manual, regardless of country code inclusion.
